name: Marija Babić
bio:
Marija Babić's path to motorsport was somewhat unconventional, having started her career as a software developer for industrial machinery. A lifelong fascination with racing simulations led her to begin modding games in her spare time, eventually building a reputation for creating incredibly realistic vehicle dynamics. This passion project evolved into a full-time pursuit when she realized the potential for applying her skills to professional racing simulators.

As a simulator engineer, Marija is meticulous and demanding, both of herself and those around her. She believes in a data-driven approach, constantly seeking to refine and improve the accuracy of the simulator. While her management skills are still developing, her technical expertise and innovative ideas make her a valuable asset to any team looking to gain an edge through simulation. Her ambition drives her to continually push the boundaries of what's possible within the virtual racing environment.

physical.description: Marija has a serious demeanor etched into her weathered face.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with equations and technical diagrams.
Insists on complete silence during simulation runs, even from remote observers.
Has a habit of muttering technical jargon under her breath when concentrating.
